submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the current token when it is a lexical marker of quantified population inquiry or hedged generalization: survey/poll/study/research/rate language (including the ' poll' subword even inside semantically unrelated words like 'pollination'), the hedges 'may'/'might', the quantifier 'many', and the paragraph-break newline token that segments multi-paragraph expository text. It does not fire on generic academic nouns (report, data, evidence, findings), other modals/adverbs (could, often), or other quantity words (several, various), so it is narrower than an academic-register or hedging detector.
